reviews.text: We've known Nerea for over four years, and I can't thank her enough for how well she's treated our dog. She first took care of her when she was just a few months old and a whirlwind. She's always happy with her. The grooming service is also fantastic. Highly recommended.

Nerea takes care of Emmy when we're not there, and she does a fantastic job. Emmy is always happy when we drop her off and when we pick her up. Nerea treats her like family. I'm very happy and at ease leaving her in her care. Highly recommended.

We've left our dog there several times and they've always taken excellent care of him. They're very attentive, affectionate, and inspire a lot of confidence. Without a doubt, a highly recommended place.

After a long search, we found Ikican and we couldn't be happier with the experience! My dog ​​Paul has a fantastic time and they take great care of him, just like he's at home. Without a doubt, the best option for doggy daycare and boarding. We also tried their grooming service and loved it!
We couldn't be happier with this daycare. The service is outstanding, and their professionalism is evident. Knowing your child is in such good hands is incredibly reassuring. Highly recommended.

This is a fantastic dog daycare!
We've been taking my dog ​​there for a few months now on the days I'm away from home, and she's absolutely delighted. She goes wild when we arrive, and then when we get home, she sleeps through the day from all the playing she does there. I highly recommend it!

Spectacular service. We took our dog for grooming and were delighted; the service was top-notch and they were very professional. Highly recommended if you want your furry friend to leave clean and happy.

I've been taking my dog, Río, since Nerea started this project practically, and he couldn't be happier. Every time I take him, he sniffs around and gets super excited. He's already made lots of friends there and plays a ton. Nerea treats them all like they're her own dogs. I've also left him for longer periods, and he's been incredibly well cared for, so I've been able to leave with peace of mind.
I recommend it 100%, vouched for by my dog ​​🐶

We were incredibly lucky to find this daycare. Nerea and her colleagues are so lovely; they treat both my son and us with the utmost care. Quillo loves going there.
They adapt to our needs without any problem, always with a smile.
They are wonderful ❤️
The best daycare and grooming salon to leave your furry friends at. The dogs always want to come back 🧡 So grateful for all the love Nerea puts into caring for our pups 🐕 …

I've been taking my dog ​​to the doggy daycare for a few months now, and everything has been great. They have a real way with dogs, and it shows. Tarja is very timid and fearful around strangers, but Nerea and her mother quickly won her over. She's always happy going there and often doesn't even want to leave—that says it all. Another plus is that even though I usually take her at the same time, if something unexpected happens and we have to drop her off a little earlier or pick her up later, they've never given me any trouble. They also offer a bathing service, so I sometimes take advantage of the morning at the daycare to get Tarja pampered. In short, it's a highly recommended place to leave your dogs, with the complete peace of mind that they'll be very well cared for.

I never thought I'd ever leave my little guy at a doggy daycare, and honestly, it's been such a great decision… Leo is so happy when he goes; it's his second home, and he plays a lot with his toy dog, haha.
It's not just a daycare; it's so much more. They love him like he's their own. Nerea is amazing with the dogs, and Leo adores her.
I'm thrilled with it and recommend it 100%. They're super supervised and well cared for.

🤎🤎

We are delighted with Ikican daycare. Our dog Milo is very happy going there and his behavior has improved a lot, as he was quite fearful when he came from a shelter. Nerea definitely has a gift with animals.
It's a fantastic daycare. My dog ​​Cooper is thrilled with his friends and the staff. Nerea is a delight. I highly recommend it.

I had never left our dog in someone else's care before… until I met Nerea, who is WONDERFUL. She has a pure love for animals, and she's incredibly kind and attentive to the dogs. Nora, our dog, enjoys herself, goes happily, and interacts with lots of different dogs. You can really see that when she goes to the park or is with other dogs because she learned to socialize from a very young age thanks to Ikican and the wonderful atmosphere they've created at the kennel. It's such a pleasure to find people like her in the world!

From La Peineta Veterinary Clinic, and personally, we congratulate you on your excellent and highly successful work in helping with the socialization, training, and fun of all the dogs that attend your doggy daycare. Best regards.
Hi, we took Gus there for the first time the other day. And everything was fantastic. The staff were lovely, everything was very clean, and the dog seemed very happy. We'll be back.
She was very good at cutting and washing my dog, and took great care.
A wonderful place to leave your canine companion knowing with complete certainty that they are in good hands 💖 …

Nerea has taken wonderful care of our little girl; she's been very attentive and has answered every time we've asked about her, sending us photos. We'd be delighted to come back another day so Lana isn't alone. Thank you!!
